service.name: Live music for a birthday party
service.serviceType: A band, a jazz duo, a singer with a guitar or a Spanish guitarist for 30th, 40th, 50th and 60th birthday parties and surprise parties
service.description: Live music for a milestone birthday party across Denver and the Front Range: a trio or quartet for the 30th and 40th that dance, a jazz duo at 65 to 72 dBA under the 50th's dinner and toasts, a solo musician or a duo for the 60th and past it, a singer who learns the birthday song the guest of honour actually wants, at home, at a club or in a private dining space, with an announcement microphone for the toasts and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can we hire a band for a birthday party?
faqs.a: Yes, and the size follows the number on the cake: a trio or a quartet for a 30th or a 40th that ends on a dance floor, a jazz duo for a 50th that's a dinner with a toast in it, and one musician or a duo from arrival through dessert for a 60th and past it. It's one contract with one personal contact, booked through Signet Artists in Denver.

faqs.q: What size band for a 40th birthday party?
faqs.a: A trio or a quartet. A trio plays the dinner quietly and fills the floor afterward without a stage, and a quartet is the size for a club or a venue past a hundred guests. The DJ can carry the late end through the same sound system.

faqs.q: How do you handle a surprise birthday party?
faqs.a: The musicians are set up early and playing quietly, so the place looks like it simply has live music that night, and the guest of honor's song starts on a cue you and the band agree beforehand: a nod from the host or a text from the door.

faqs.q: Can the band learn the birthday person's favorite songs?
faqs.a: Yes. One learned song comes with every booking, and each one after it is its own line on the quote.

faqs.q: Can a band play a birthday party at home?
faqs.a: Yes. A solo musician takes about 6 by 4 feet on one dedicated circuit, a duo 8 by 6 and a trio 12 by 8, in the corner the party naturally faces, and every size plays dinner at a level the table talks across. Outdoors it plays on a covered, level and dry spot with power run to it, and whatever limit the HOA or the neighborhood puts on evening sound goes into the contract. An announcement microphone for the toasts comes with every size.
